headline: Two unused science capstone courses approved for deletion; updated policies on restraint, bloodborne pathogens, and hiring checks presented.
summary: The courses have had no requests in 5 years. They will come off the catalog, but the district will keep them on file in case interest returns. Four policies were updated to model language from Shipman & Goodwin, including a same-day parent notice rule for restraint and seclusion. The policies will go on the next consent agenda.
decisions: Approved deleting the Science Capstone Research course from the catalog.
Approved deleting the Science Capstone Experience course; the motion carried.
discussion: Science capstone courses: Those presenting said one course covers research and the other covers the project experience. The courses will stay on file in case interest returns.
Employment checks policy: Optional language checking out-of-state registries for applicants was kept, after the policy committee agreed with it.
Restraint and seclusion policy: Parent notice changed from within 24 hours to the same day a student is placed in restraint or seclusion, under Public Act 26-1.

decision_evidence.quote: Make a motion to delete the course Science Capstone Research. Do I have a second? ... Okay, so we will We've approved deleting that course.
Make a motion to delete Science Capstone Experience. Do I have a second? ... All opposed? Abstentions? Motion carries.

Deletion of Science Capstone Experience course
